changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN flexible_minimum_to_start numeric(19, 4), ADD COLUMN flexible_minimum_contribution numeric(19, 4), ADD COLUMN flexible_gain_share_pct numeric(5, 2), ADD COLUMN flexible_inactivity_months integer, ADD COLUMN flexible_notice_days integer, ADD COLUMN flexible_max_months integer, ADD COLUMN flexible_finish_by date, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_only_for_instalments, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_whole, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_only_for_plans CHECK (plan_id IS NULL OR plan IN ('INSTALLMENT', 'FLEXIBLE')), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_whole CHECK ((plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_name IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_total IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_premium IS NULL) AND (CASE WHEN plan = 'FLEXIBLE' THEN plan_frequency IS NULL AND deposit_amount IS NULL ELSE (plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_frequency IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (deposit_amount IS NULL) END)), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_flexible_terms CHECK (CASE WHEN plan = 'FLEXIBLE' THEN plan_id IS NOT NULL AND flexible_minimum_to_start > 0 AND (flexible_minimum_contribution IS NULL OR flexible_minimum_contribution > 0) AND flexible_gain_share_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100 AND flexible_inactivity_months >= 6 AND flexible_notice_days >= 30 AND (flexible_max_months IS NULL) = (flexible_finish_by IS NULL) AND (flexible_max_months IS NULL OR flexible_max_months >= 12) AND escrow_deduction_pct IS NOT NULL ELSE flexible_minimum_to_start IS NULL AND flexible_minimum_contribution IS NULL AND flexible_gain_share_pct IS NULL AND flexible_inactivity_months IS NULL AND flexible_notice_days IS NULL AND flexible_max_months IS NULL AND flexible_finish_by IS NULL END);
COMMENT ON COLUMN transactions.flexible_minimum_to_start IS 'Flexible: the first payment''s minimum, a share of the agreed price, copied when the purchase opened.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN transactions.flexible_gain_share_pct IS 'Flexible: the share of any gain the developer keeps, on leaving or on a buyer-requested sale, copied when the purchase opened.'; COMMENT ON COLUMN transactions.flexible_finish_by IS 'Flexible: the offer date plus the maximum time to finish, in Lagos. Null when the plan declared none.';
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM transactions WHERE plan = 'FLEXIBLE'; ALTER TABLE transactions DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_flexible_terms, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_whole, DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_only_for_plans, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_only_for_instalments CHECK (plan_id IS NULL OR plan = 'INSTALLMENT'), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_plan_whole CHECK ((plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_name IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_frequency IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_total IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (plan_premium IS NULL) AND (plan_id IS NULL) = (deposit_amount IS NULL)), DROP COLUMN flexible_finish_by, DROP COLUMN flexible_max_months, DROP COLUMN flexible_notice_days, DROP COLUMN flexible_inactivity_months, DROP COLUMN flexible_gain_share_pct, DROP COLUMN flexible_minimum_contribution, DROP COLUMN flexible_minimum_to_start;
